exact_statement: For every finite n>=0 and every Boolean sign f on the uniform {-1,1}^n cube, let a_S=hat f(S), epsilon_i=Inf_i(f), I=sum_i epsilon_i, H2=sum_{i<j}a_{ij}^2 log2(1/a_{ij}^2), and T12=sum_i sum_{j!=i}phi(a_i^2,a_{ij}^2), where phi(x,y)=(x+y)h2(y/(x+y)) with zero terms by continuity and entropy in bits. Then H2<=(155600/50301)I and T12<=(16700/2187)I<8I whenever I>0; all quantities vanish for constants. The self-contained Boolean derivative estimate sum_{j!=i}a_{ij}^2<=2 epsilon_i^2 ln(2/epsilon_i) and the subprobability pair reference Q({i,j})=2 epsilon_i epsilon_j/I^2 establish the bound. Normalized real spectral vectors without full Booleanity admit T12/I_spectral growing without bound; no claim on erasure edges starting at levels >=2 is made.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean sign, equivalently full signed Boolean convolution identities
Entropy in bits; natural logarithms explicitly denoted ln

exact_statement: For every fixed integer ell>=2 and every finite-valued s:N->[0,infinity) with s(N)=o(N), define R_geell(F)=sum_i sum_(T subset [N] minus {i}, |T|>=ell) phi(Fhat(T)^2,Fhat(T union {i})^2), where phi(x,y)=(x+y)h2(y/(x+y)) in bits with continuous zero conventions. The supremum K_geell(s) of R_geell(F)/I(F) over all finite N-bit Boolean signs with 0<I(F)<=2^-s(N) equals K_E=sup_(all finite nonconstant Boolean f) B(f)/I(f), in the extended reals. For every actual seed f and integers m,k>=1, let h=chi_Z*f^tensor(m) on ell fresh parity bits, F=1+A_k(h-1), q=2^-k, with all blocks disjoint. Then B_data(F)=qmB(f), I(F)=q(mI(f)+ell+k), R_geell(F)=qmB(f)+kq+2kq^2 sum_(r=ell..k-1) binom(k-1,r), and R_ge2(F)=qmB(f)+2kq(1-kq). Each parity coordinate z has B_z(F)=0 and Inf_z(F)=q>0, so min_(i relevant) B_i(F)/Inf_i(F)=0. No finiteness of K_E or selected-witness transport is asserted.
hypotheses: Uniform finite physical cube; actual Boolean signs; normalized Fourier coefficients
Bits, ordinary influence, continuous zero conventions
ell>=2 fixed; m,k positive; all blocks disjoint
Finite-valued nonnegative s(N)=o(N), not necessarily monotone

exact_statement: For every finite Boolean seed f, every m,k>=1 and ell>=2 on disjoint uniform blocks, let h=chi_Z product_b f_b, J=mI(f)+ell, F=1+A_k(h-1), q=2^-k, d=(1-q)^2+q^2. For each relevant coordinate use mu_i(T)=p_(T+i)/Inf_i and r_i(T)=p_T+p_(T+i); both normalize to one. Let M=sum_i Inf_i[log2(1/Inf_i)-D(mu_i||r_i)] and D_f be the KL divergence of the normalized joint derivative/reference laws, with I(f)D_f=0 for constants. Original core-coordinate divergences obey D_i(F)=D_i(h)+k, D_i(h)=D_i(f) on seed blocks and D_i(h)=0 on parity bits. Every control divergence is D_c=(1-q)(k-1)+q log2(q/d). Consequently I(F)=q(J+k), I(F)D_F=q[mI(f)D_f+kJ+kD_c], M(F)=qmM(f)+k[q(1-q)+q^2 log2(d/q^2)], and M_ge2(F)=qmM(f)+kq(1-kq). For every fixed ell>=2 and finite nonnegative s(N)=o(N), the supremum of M_geell/I over 0<I<=2^-s(N) equals the unrestricted supremum K_M in the extended reals. No finiteness of K_M, universal refund payment or full FEI conclusion is asserted.
hypotheses: Actual Boolean signs, normalized Fourier spectrum and ordinary physical influence
Uniform finite disjoint blocks; m,k>=1 and ell>=2; entropy/KL in bits
Zero terms by continuity; irrelevant coordinates omitted; constants treated by I D=0 convention
Sublinear cutoff finite nonnegative, not required monotone
